offline: You're offline. Typed lookups still work.
offline_body: Photo identification needs a connection. Typed lookups work offline and give the same answers.
INVALID_REQUEST_title: Something was wrong with that request
INVALID_REQUEST_body: We could not read what was sent. Try again, or type the name instead.
UNAUTHENTICATED_body: We could not start a session. Try again in a moment — typed lookups keep working either way.
ATTESTATION_FAILED_title: We could not verify this device
ATTESTATION_FAILED_body: Photo identification is unavailable on this device right now. Typed lookups still work.
SPEND_CAP_EXCEEDED_title: Photo checks are paused for today
SPEND_CAP_EXCEEDED_body: This is a free app with a daily limit on photo identification, and today's is used up. Typed lookups, verdicts and emergency numbers all still work.
RATE_LIMITED_body: Give it a minute and try again. Typed lookups are not limited.
IMAGE_UNUSABLE_title: That photo is hard to read
IMAGE_UNUSABLE_body: Try again in better light, closer in, or with the item on a plain background. You can also just type what it is.
NO_SUBJECT_FOUND_title: We could not find anything to identify
NO_SUBJECT_FOUND_body: There may be too much in the frame. Try a photo of the single item, or type what it is.
PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE_body: This is on our side, not yours. Typed lookups work as normal and give the same answers.
INTERNAL_body: We logged it. Typed lookups still work, and emergency numbers are always available.
